name: gpio
description: GPIO: General Purpose Input/Output — 16 software-driven pins with direction, output, input, edge detect

registers.name: DIR
registers.desc: bit i = 1 means pin i is output, 0 means input

registers.name: OUT
registers.desc: output value for pins where DIR=1

registers.name: IN
registers.desc: simulated input value (driven by software for testing)

registers.name: PIN
registers.desc: effective pin state: DIR ? OUT : IN

registers.name: EDGE
registers.desc: sticky rising-edge latches per pin (clears on read)
